newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 228 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes softer at 228 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev fell to 228 to the dollar at the close from 226 in the morning despite central bank support after foreign currency demand edged up on the local interbank market, dealers said.
"Final clients which urgently needed foreign currency paid 228 levs per dollar at the close," one dealer said.
The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) sold foreign currency for most of the day, offering volumes of $200,000-$300,000 per bank to selected commercial banks at around 226 levs per dollar, dealers said.
A slight rise of dollar demand in the afternoon prompted the banks, through which the BNB offered foreign currency to the market, raise their asks for the dollar by two levs to 228, traders said.
The central bank has been reported selling foreign currency since Friday when the lev fell to 236-238 to the dollar.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
